decision_rules.scale: Verified commercial evidence meets or exceeds success threshold and economics are plausible.
decision_rules.iterate: Signal exists but threshold/economics are not yet strong enough; change one major variable and retest.
decision_rules.hold: Potentially attractive but blocked by timing, dependency, evidence gap, or owner decision.
decision_rules.kill: Repeated credible tests fail, economics are structurally unattractive, or weighted score remains below 50 after evidence collection.

notes: Unknown values remain null. Never fabricate economics, demand, conversion, CAC, margin, or willingness to pay.
